scope: New finite core, exact decode GPU runner, 26 core and 19 runner synthetic contracts; static inspection only. No runtime policy change.
checks: Snapshot classification is disjoint for GPU-only/L2-only/both/sole/empty; exact dimensions, occupied-ID uniqueness and cursor are checked. It classifies only captured endpoint membership.

Possible support is actual decode-entry mirror IDs union all strictly earlier occupied GPU victims. Current victims are added after analyzing a plan; no last-K/FIFO assumption or simulated lower-cache state.

Latest prior victim gap is p-q; strictly intervening victim count excludes the whole source and demand plans q and p. Entry-origin support receives no invented eviction time. First eviction and first miss are independent and right-censored at255.

Each side checks C against sum min(K,total supported misses); common/only capacities are capped separately. max(0,C-Uonly)..min(C,Ucommon) is a conservative outer interval, and per-layer S-L interval subtraction followed by sums remains conservative. Nonempty intervals follow from C<=Utotal<=Ucommon+Uonly.

Core contracts include a finite independent subset-enumeration oracle for all25 observed-count pair combinations, cap competition, last-K counterexample, order mismatch, source exhaustion, and invalid local plan facts.

Runner consumes each full selected trace through EOF, including prefill records without policy replay. Every true decode row uses immutable successful-path GPU planning; 4 cumulative prefixes, all48 physical GPU endpoints, source/observer/l2-clock closure and exact97920 layer-plan count are mandatory.

A corrupt trailer, wrong forward/prefix/endpoint/source identity, invalid observation or incomplete collection prevents pass. Partial results/plans retain false completion; outputs use exclusive creation and tracked/outside artifact paths are rejected.

The fixed 8-request manifest, exact source ledgers, parser input bindings and runtime identity are checked; same-source passed host-contract receipt is required before actual analysis. All bound files are SHA checked before and after analysis. Full actual-trace execution plan remains to be frozen.

Primary candidate gate requires k1 equal input lengths AND token-sidecar SHA equality AND ordered needed-route equality across48 layers AND strictly positive common interval lower bound AND mixed GPU-covered/sole occupancy in a single captured decode-entry layer on either side.

All k0..k3 comparisons remain; differing inputs/routes are explicit. Candidate output is only one future rule for consideration; no implementation, lower-cache replay, speed/physical I/O claim or automatic added observer.

first_static_findings.finding: Frozen scope said captured endpoints without specifying which endpoint; draft runner and contract already required primary decode-entry only.
first_static_findings.resolution: Root explicitly confirmed before first tests and actual trace analysis: only k1 snapshots[1], with GPU-covered and sole occupants in the same layer on one side; do not expand to other endpoints after seeing results. This is a conservative admission interpretation, not evidence of actual overwrite alternatives.

first_static_findings.finding: Root identified that equal input length and equal ordered routes do not establish equal input token bytes.
first_static_findings.resolution: Final runner emits both token-sidecar SHA values and same_input_tokens, requires equality at the primary gate, and adds a differing-token/equal-length/equal-route positive-bound counterexample. Existing manifest bindings are reused without re-extraction.

first_static_findings.finding: Inherited owned.run default cwd was bound when the old module was defined; assigning owned.W does not change that default argument.
first_static_findings.resolution: Root confirmed every new owned invocation will pass explicit cwd=W and TMPDIR=R. Only existing run helper is reused; old frozen/export entrypoints are not called.

first_static_findings.finding: Runner fills report.source_sha256 only on successful completion; failure reports retain scope/manifest/execution_plan SHA rather than embedding the full source ledger.
first_static_findings.resolution: Accepted within the externally frozen owned-execution scope; failed report must not be described as containing a complete standalone source ledger. No unrelated test expansion requested.

limits: No tests, imports of new modules, actual-input statistics, route parsing, model inference, build, or payload reads were performed by this static reviewer. AST parsing and source hashes are not contract execution.

Finite oracle candidate subsets deliberately relax real cache history and concurrency; containment is validated conceptually, not joint attainability. Positive lower bounds exclude only a contemporaneous miss-set-composition explanation, not historical demand/writeback effects.

Endpoint mixed occupancy does not prove that a GPU-covered alternative existed at the actual reservation, stayed GPU-covered, or could safely be recycled. The concrete future rule still needs its own runtime conditions and acceptance stage.

Only the first frozen synthetic host-contract batch is admitted by this review. Actual eight-trace analysis still requires passed same-source45 contracts, clean tool commit and frozen execution/source identity.
